privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.subtitle: How Nádražky handles your personal data. Last updated {date}.

summary.browse: You can browse Nádražky without an account. There is no analytics, no advertising and no tracking.
summary.google: To check in, you sign in with Google. We keep your name, email and profile picture from Google, and the username you choose.
summary.checkins: Checking in doesn't use your location. We store the pub, the time and the details you add.
summary.public: Your username and check-ins are public on the pub's page. You can have your account and everything in it deleted at any time.

controller.title: Who is responsible
controller.p1: Nádražky is run by {name}, a private individual, who is the controller of your personal data. Write to <email></email> with any question or request about your data.

browsing.title: Browsing without an account
browsing.p1: Anyone can look at the pubs, the map and the check-ins without an account. We don't use analytics, advertising or tracking cookies. Some data is still handled to show you the site:
browsing.logs: Server logs. Our hosting provider, Vercel, handles every request and briefly records technical data such as your IP address, browser and the page you asked for, to deliver the site and keep it secure.
browsing.map: Map tiles. Maps are loaded from OpenFreeMap, so your browser sends it your IP address when you open a map.
browsing.language: Language. A NEXT_LOCALE cookie remembers which language you use.

account.title: Your account
account.p1: You can sign up only with a Google account. When you sign in, Google gives us your name, email address, profile picture and an ID for your Google account, and we store these to recognise you. We never see your Google password, and we don't keep Google's access tokens.
account.p2: When you finish signing up, you choose a username and a language and confirm that you are 18 or over. We store the username, the language and when you confirmed your age.
account.p3: Your username is public. Your name and email address are visible only to you and to us.

checkins.title: Check-ins
checkins.p1: Checking in doesn't use your phone's location: we never ask for it and never store it.
checkins.p2: For each check-in we store the pub, the time, whether the pub was open, and the details you add: what you had, a rating and a note.
checkins.p3: Check-ins are public: the pub's page shows your username with the time, the details and your note.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: We only use cookies the site needs to work, so we don't ask for consent:
cookies.session: Sign-in cookies (names starting with authjs, __Secure-authjs or __Host-authjs) keep you signed in and protect the sign-in from forgery. They last until you log out, or 90 days without a visit.

basis.title: Why we may use your data
basis.account: Your account and check-ins: to provide the service you signed up for (Article 6(1)(b) GDPR).
basis.logs: Server logs: our legitimate interest in running a reliable and secure site (Article 6(1)(f) GDPR).

processors.title: Who else handles your data
processors.p1: We don't sell your data or share it for advertising. These services handle it for us:
processors.vercel: Vercel hosts the site; its server functions run in Frankfurt, Germany.
processors.neon: Neon stores the database, also in Frankfurt.
processors.google: Google provides sign-in, under its own privacy policy.
processors.p2: Vercel and Neon are US companies working for us under data processing agreements. Where data may leave the EU, they rely on safeguards such as the EU standard contractual clauses.

retention.title: How long we keep it
retention.account: Your account, profile and check-ins: until your account is deleted. Deleting it removes your check-ins too.
retention.session: Sign-in cookies: until you log out, at most 90 days without a visit.
retention.logs: Vercel's server logs: a short time, as set by Vercel.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.p1: You can ask for a copy of your data, to correct it, to delete it or your whole account, to restrict or object to its use, or to get it in a portable format. Write to <email></email>; we will reply within one month.
rights.p2: You can also complain to the Czech data protection authority, the <uoou>Office for Personal Data Protection (ÚOOÚ)</uoou>, or to the authority where you live.

age.title: Adults only
age.p1: Nádražky is about pubs and is for adults: you must be 18 or over to sign up.

changes.title: Changes
changes.p1: If we change how we handle your data, we will update this page and the date at the top.
